description: Create a recurring Feed API report schedule that subscribes to an ACTIVE schedule template: feedType and scheduleTemplateId, plus scheduleName, preferredTriggerHour/DayOfWeek/DayOfMonth, scheduleStartDate/EndDate and schemaVersion as the template requires (read it with ebay_get_feed_schedule_template). eBay answers 201; returns scheduleId and Location. Schedules per feed type are limited (error 160031). Schedules exist only for LMS_ORDER_REPORT, which requires sell.fulfillment.

schedule.description: CreateUserScheduleRequest body; include every field the template requires

feedType.description: Feed type of the template; currently only LMS_ORDER_REPORT

preferredTriggerDayOfMonth.description: Day of month, 1-31, for monthly schedules; days past the end of the month use the last day

preferredTriggerDayOfWeek.description: DayOfWeekEnum for weekly schedules: MONDAY ... SUNDAY; available as the template allows

preferredTriggerHour.description: Two-digit UTC trigger hour, 00Z-23Z, e.g. 11Z; available as the template allows

scheduleEndDate.description: UTC end timestamp after scheduleStartDate; the schedule then becomes INACTIVE

scheduleStartDate.description: UTC start timestamp, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:00:00.000Z; available as the template allows

scheduleTemplateId.description: ACTIVE schedule template ID from ebay_get_feed_schedule_templates

schemaVersion.description: Schema version of the report, when the template requires it

name: ebay_create_feed_schedule
